basic_info.description: 171 Liberty Street is a 12,600 square foot multifamily property on a 5,700 square foot lot in Eureka Valley, known for having a sunny and warm micro-climate and eclectic mix of trendy restaurants, popular bars, cafes, and coffee shops. The property is comprised of twelve (12) - 1 BD / 1 BA units, along with four (4) parking spaces and a backyard. The units feature hardwood floors, granite countertops, bay windows (in-some units), generous closet space and are separately metered for gas & electricity.     This mid-block apartment building is conveniently located a block away from Mission Dolores Park and a short walk to the Valencia Street corridor. Excellent public transportation and bike-friendly streets further enhance the property location. 171 Liberty Street is minutes from the 16th Street and the 24th Street Bart Stations, in addition to several bus lines providing easy access to all areas of the city.     171 Liberty Street presents a unique opportunity for investors to own a piece of San Francisco's iconic real estate in the affluent Eureka Valley neighborhood. With its prime location, desirable amenities, and strong rental upside, this property is poised to deliver both immediate and long-term returns.
